$schema: informal — concept slug -> the lesson that FIRST teaches it, in course order
howToUse: Authors declare INTRODUCES / ASSUMES in their spec; those lists are mirrored here.
The Continuity Editor FAILS any lesson that uses a concept whose ledger 'order' is GREATER than the lesson's own order.
'order' is the course sequence index (1-31). 'lesson' is the id that first teaches the concept.
Java-track concepts are NOT listed here: all core Java is assumed by Phase 2 (see content/specs/_shared-conventions.md §1).
Forward TEASERS are allowed and encouraged ('Unit 7 makes this real'); forward USE is not.
